relations.support_notes:
Colophon (ID:7973), fol. 194a3-4: las kyi me long gi btam rgyud rnaM par bshad pa zhes bya ba ¦ mang du thos pa shag kya’i dge slong bsod nams rin chen gyis rang gi gzhung gi ‘grel par sbyar ba ¦ rdzogs s+ho || shakya’i dge slong bsod naMs rin chen gyis gzhan la sbyin par bya ba’i chos su bzhengs pa’o ||
Compare with the colophon of (ID:5246).

comments: The signature "phyi la 588" on the cover page suggests that the manuscript was part of the gNas bcu lha khang collection.
